about: Quill Radio's curated networks: each channel pinned to the operator's own published stream. Read by quill/core/radio/curated_networks.py; re-checked and refreshed by scripts/refresh_radio_networks.py, never by the app.
attribution: The network list and stream addresses come from BlindRadio by serrebidev (https://github.com/serrebidev/blindradio), crates/blindradio-core/data/networks.json and docs/radio-directory-sources.md, used under the MIT License that follows. Quill Radio regrouped them, left out seasonal channels, and re-checked every address.

networks.name: BBC
networks.origin: BBC's own station list API (rms.api.bbc.co.uk/v2/experience/inline/stations) names the services; each address is the BBC's own HLS stream on as-hls-ww-live.akamaized.net, from BlindRadio's 2026-11-03 audit. Services whose audio answers 403 outside the UK are left out.

networks.name: ABC (Australia)
networks.origin: The ABC's own HLS streams on streaming.abc-cdn.net.au, one per region, from BlindRadio's 2026-11-03 audit.

networks.name: Radio Swiss (SRG SSR)
networks.origin: SRG SSR's own streams, stream.srg-ssr.ch/m/<channel>/mp3_128, from BlindRadio's 2026-10-28 source notes.

networks.name: Minnesota Public Radio and YourClassical
networks.origin: <name>.stream.publicradio.org/<name>.mp3, as listed on the YourClassical streams page (yourclassical.org/listen/streams); seasonal streams left out. From BlindRadio's 2026-11-03 audit.

networks.name: WFMU
networks.origin: WFMU's stream help page (wfmu.org/ssaudionet.shtml) and its channel playlists (wfmu_rock.pls, wfmu_drummer.pls, wfmu_sheena.pls), from BlindRadio's 2026-10-28 source notes.

networks.name: WFUV
networks.origin: WFUV's own StreamGuys stream, wfuv-onair.streamguys.org/onair-hi, from BlindRadio's 2026-10-28 source notes.

channels.name: WFUV
channels.http_reason: WFUV's HTTPS address sends an incomplete certificate chain, so a verified TLS connection fails (checked 2026-11-07); the same stream over HTTP answers audio.

networks.name: Big R Radio
networks.origin: The station table in bigrradio.com's own /assets/app.js (names and ais-edge82-bigr-dal03.cdnstream.com/<id>_128 streams), from BlindRadio's 2026-10-28 source notes. The list is read from the site's script, so it can go out of date without warning; the probe catches that.

networks.name: NTS and its Infinite Mixtapes
networks.origin: NTS 1 and NTS 2 from NTS's own support article (stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net); the Infinite Mixtapes from NTS's public API (www.nts.live/api/v2/mixtapes, each audio_stream_endpoint). Refreshable from that API.

networks.name: Nightride FM
networks.origin: The station's own mounts on stream.nightride.fm (the .mp3 ones; the .m4a ones the page advertises do not answer), from BlindRadio's 2026-10-28 source notes.

networks.name: Power Hitz
networks.origin: The stream table in the Power Hitz player page (live.powerhitz.com/<channel>), distinct channels only and the Christmas channel left out, from BlindRadio's 2026-10-28 source notes.

networks.name: Radio Record
networks.origin: Radio Record's public station API (www.radiorecord.ru/api/stations/), each channel's stream on radiorecord.hostingradio.ru. Refreshable from that API.

networks.name: PulsRadio
networks.origin: The site's own player data, eight channels on icecast.pulsradio.com, from BlindRadio's 2026-10-28 source notes (the mount names do not match the channel names, so they are recorded rather than guessed).

networks.name: Sunshine Live
networks.origin: The network's own mp3-192 mounts on stream.sunshine-live.de, from BlindRadio's 2026-10-28 source notes.

networks.name: Planet Radio and FFH
networks.origin: The channel table in planetradio.de's own page (data-streamurl on mp3.ffh.de), from BlindRadio's 2026-10-28 source notes. Christmas channels left out here.

networks.name: Global (UK): Capital, Heart, Smooth, Classic FM, LBC, Radio X, Gold
networks.origin: Global's shared Icecast host, media-ice.musicradio.com/<Name>MP3, the London feed of each brand, from BlindRadio's 2026-10-28 source notes and 2026-11-03 audit. Heart Xmas is seasonal and left out.

networks.name: Triple M (Australia)
networks.origin: Southern Cross Austereo's own streams (legacy.scahw.com.au and scastream.com.au), found through BlindRadio's 2026-11-03 audit.

networks.name: ARN (Australia): KIIS, Gold, Mix, WSFM
networks.origin: ARN's own StreamGuys mounts (ais-arn.streamguys1.com), found through BlindRadio's 2026-11-03 audit.

networks.name: NZME (New Zealand)
networks.origin: NZME's StreamTheWorld mounts NZME_01 to NZME_74, each naming itself in its ICY metadata, from BlindRadio's 2026-11-03 audit.

networks.name: K-LOVE
networks.origin: EMF's own streams on maestro.emfcdn.com, found through BlindRadio's 2026-11-03 audit.

networks.name: Air1
networks.origin: EMF's own streams on maestro.emfcdn.com, found through BlindRadio's 2026-11-03 audit.
